# UX Requirements Checklist: Translation-First Caption Layout

**Purpose**: Review whether the requirements define a complete, testable translation-first hierarchy
**Created**: 2026-10-25
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are requirements present for successful, loading, paused, unavailable, and long-text translation states? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004–FR-005]
- [ ] CHK002 Are requirements present for retaining the original caption, CEFR highlighting, and above-level vocabulary after reordering? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007–FR-010]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK003 Is “prominent” quantified through document order, relative type size, contrast, and region dimensions? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002–FR-004, SC-002]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the intended relationship among translation, explanation, original text, and vocabulary unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006–FR-009]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK005 Can the translation-first hierarchy be objectively verified in visual and keyboard reading order? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK006 Are stable geometry and narrow-panel behavior defined with measurable boundaries? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003–SC-004]

## Non-Functional Coverage

- [ ] CHK007 Are keyboard focus, scrolling, wrapping, and horizontal-overflow expectations defined for both text regions? [Coverage, Spec §FR-004, FR-008, FR-011]
- [ ] CHK008 Does the specification explicitly prevent scope creep into permissions, networking, storage, models, or runtime behavior? [Scope, Spec §FR-010–FR-012]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after reviewer evaluation.
- These items assess the requirements, not the finished implementation.
